audit.why: Pantheon 1 / Skill 2 / Singed 3-4 / Pantheon 6 / Singed at both item stages, agreed across both layers, and consistent with 51.46% over 616 games: Pantheon's early edge decays into a drain-tank he cannot kill.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers, and the level-6 spike said only 'he just runs'.
audit.why: Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s at 125 range; Mega Adhesive is 17/16/15/14/13s at 1000; Insanity Potion is a flat 100s. The 17-second Mega Adhesive cooldown is the actual gate on whether you can engage him at all.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive's 17s and 1000 range and Fling's 125 range written into early, mid, breakdown.cooldowns and loading; Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds added to the late-game spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five strings call Fling his W. Fling is his E. His W is Mega Adhesive, which the matchup never mentions at all.
audit.why: Riot: Fling (E) damages a target and flings them into the air behind Singed, rooting them if they land in his Mega Adhesive. Mega Adhesive (W) slows and grounds enemies who walk on it. The page names the wrong slot and omits the ability that actually decides the matchup.
audit.corrected: Fling named as E with its 125 range; Mega Adhesive named as W with its 17s cooldown and its grounding.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grounding is never mentioned, in a matchup where it is the decisive interaction.
audit.why: Mega Adhesive grounds — Riot's own description says so. Shield Vault is Pantheon's only gap-closer and it is a dash. Standing in the puddle, your engage simply does not fire.
audit.corrected: Written into early, mid, whys[3], whys[4], whys[6], spikes[1] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said Fling cancels Aegis Assault, and the page advises the opposite — 'hold your E block when he tries to fling you'.
audit.why: Fling is a knock-up and Aegis Assault is a channel; the knock-up ends the channel. Holding E for his Fling is holding it to be cancelled. The _missing-interactions file flags this exact pairing.
audit.corrected: Reversed in early, whys[2] and wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Insanity Potion was never named and its anti-heal was never mentioned.
audit.why: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, so Pantheon's Sundered Sky healing is cut for as long as he stands in poison.
audit.corrected: Added to whys[5], spikes[3] and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Passive shield + Q poke wins level 1 outright'.
audit.why: Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will; he has no passive shield.

edits.after: With all three basics Q-W-E is a premier kill window — but Fling is a knock-up, so land your stun first and never channel into it.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are yours — Singed is a non-threat before his poison sustain stacks and his bases are awful. Land the point-and-click W stun and follow with an empowered Q for a heavy chunk, and hold your E block when he tries to W-fling you into the poison trail so you eat none of it. His only out is move speed, so commit when he's not already moving and you have a wall to cut off. Don't chase him into your fog or past his trail — bait the fling with E up, then punish.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are yours — Singed is a non-threat before Poison Trail sustain stacks and his bases are awful. Land the point-and-click Shield Vault and follow with an empowered Comet Spear for a heavy chunk. Know the slots: Fling is his E at 125 range and it is a knock-up, so it cancels Aegis Assault outright — do not be channelling when he steps in. Mega Adhesive is his W, 17s at rank 1 and 1000 range, and it grounds: stand in that puddle and Shield Vault will not fire at all.

edits.before: By 4-6 he stabilizes: poison trail plus his sustain mean your Q poke heals off and the lane flattens. Your kill pressure dips, so stop trying to pin a Singed who can W-fling and walk away from any single CC. At 6, Grand Starfall is a roam tool here — he'll never get caught 1v1, so leap to a side lane or a gank and turn your level-1-to-3 lead into map pressure instead of a futile chase. Keep matching his proxy so he doesn't free-farm.
edits.after: By 4-6 he stabilizes: Poison Trail plus his sustain heal off your poke and the lane flattens. Stop trying to pin a Singed who can Fling you into his own trail and walk away. The cooldown that matters is Mega Adhesive, 17s at rank 1 — while the puddle is down you can still dash onto him; while it is up, do not step in. At 6, Grand Starfall is a roam tool, so turn your early lead into map pressure rather than a futile chase.

edits.before: This is where you lose. Singed is a drain-tank who out-sustains and out-scales you: once he has move speed and Rylai's your burst can't kill through his healing and he kites you down with the poison trail. Your single W-stun is exactly the one CC he laughs off. Don't 1v1 him in the late game — group, use Grand Starfall to flank his carries, and let your tankier teammates deal with the Singed who's already run halfway across the map.
edits.after: This is where you lose. Singed out-sustains you: with move speed and Rylai's your burst cannot kill through his healing, and Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, so your own healing is cut at the same time. Mega Adhesive grounds you out of the Shield Vault escape. Don't 1v1 him in the late game — group, use Grand Starfall to flank his carries, and let your tankier teammates handle the chase.

edits.before: Passive shield + Q poke wins level 1 outright. Identify how Singed contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Mortal Will empowers your next cast and Comet Spear out-ranges his 125-unit Fling — level 1 is yours before Poison Trail matters.

edits.before: Passive shield + Q poke wins level 1 outright. Respect Singed's Fling completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Bait it, then burst. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.after: Trade around Mega Adhesive, not Fling: while the puddle is up your dash is dead, so give nothing. Puddle down, run the full pattern.

edits.after: His knock-up flip, and it ends your E channel. Engage once it is spent.

edits.before: - Pantheon vs Singed - Track: Singed Fling. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage only on Fling's cooldown. - Don't chase past the wave. - Ultimate = kill windows only.
edits.after: - Pantheon vs Singed - Mega Adhesive grounds your Shield Vault: 17s at rank 1. - Fling is E, 125 range, and cancels your channel. - Ultimate = roams only.

notes: Two things were wrong in a way that costs the player the lane. First, five separate strings call Fling his W. Fling is Singed's E (10s at rank 1, 125 range, knock-up). His W is Mega Adhesive, and the matchup never mentions it once, despite it being the ability that decides the pairing: Riot's text says it grounds enemies who walk on it, and Shield Vault is Pantheon's only gap-closer. Standing in the puddle your engage does not fire and neither does your escape. Second, the page tells the player to 'hold your E block when he tries to W-fling you' — Fling is a knock-up and Aegis Assault is a channel, so holding E for the Fling is holding it specifically to be cancelled. That advice is now reversed. Also added: Insanity Potion (100s) makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which was never mentioned anywhere and directly caps Pantheon's Sundered Sky healing in exactly the late-game scenario the page describes. NOT ASSERTED: whether Mega Adhesive's grounding also denies Grand Starfall. Grounding blocks movement abilities and the kit flags R as a dash, but Grand Starfall is a leap-and-land rather than a ground dash and I could not confirm it from the kit files, so every grounding line names Shield Vault specifically and stops there.
